notes:
- Novax's tag works: the rank list said Novax, the account is iNovaXx, so the game never found a match and showed the default rank.
- Ranks in the admin panel: make your own roles, give them to whoever you want and publish, without shipping a build.
- Connect Discord from Friends: the launcher hands out a code, !link in Discord ties it to your Minecraft account.
- The bot counts how long you play and hands out the 1h+, 5h+, 10h+ up to 1000h+ roles for it.
- !me shows your playtime, your role and your ranks, !top is the playtime leaderboard. The same as /iris me and /iris top.
